data.title: List a car for sale
data.instructions: Fill in every required field. If you do not know a value, ask your owner. Do not guess. Photos are added after the listing is created: include clear photos of the front, rear, sides, interior and odometer, and of any damage, rust or warning lights. Honest photos help the car sell.

schema.title: Registration number
schema.description: The number plate, e.g. AB07 CDE. We fetch make, model, MOT and tax from it.

schema.title: Registry
schema.description: Which agency registered the car. Only dvla (Great Britain) is supported for now.

schema.title: Condition
schema.description: Honest notes on condition, damage and history. Ask your owner if unsure.

schema.title: Does it run?
schema.description: drives: starts and can be driven today. runs-not-driveable: starts but cannot be driven. does-not-run: will not start. If unsure, ask your owner. Do not guess.

schema.title: Road legal?
schema.description: True only if it is taxed, has a valid MOT and is insured, so it is legal to drive on public roads today. If unsure, ask your owner.

schema.title: Latitude of the viewing place
schema.description: Latitude of the town where a buyer can view the car, e.g. 51.06 for Crowborough. Look it up. If you do not know where the car is, ask your owner.

schema.title: Longitude of the viewing place
schema.description: East is positive, west is negative, e.g. 0.16 for Crowborough.

schema.title: Area name
schema.description: Rough area for display, e.g. Crowborough, East Sussex.

schema.title: Delivery and collection notes
schema.description: Area, rough cost, who arranges it, and any collection place that differs from the viewing place.
